adds.title: The Marvels
adds.text: When Kree soldiers burst into the Khan home, Aamir and Yusuf fight one off together. Later, on the S.A.B.E.R. station, Aamir teases his father for being nearly as old as a centuries-old alien.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Aamir's father. They fight off a Kree soldier together.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Yusuf's son, who fights a Kree soldier beside him, then teases him on the space station.
adds.evidence: The Marvels: Aamir and Yusuf trap a Kree guard together in the living room (Aamir hits it with a coat rack); on the S.A.B.E.R. station Aamir mocks Yusuf, saying Dag is almost as old as he is; Yusuf tells Aamir to stop picking on his sister.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
adds.text: Elena is infected by a Shrike, and Mack cannot bring himself to kill her before it takes her over and she attacks him. Once May kills Izel and the Shrike dies, Mack holds Elena in his arms.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The love Mack cannot bring himself to kill when a Shrike takes her over.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Elena's love, who cannot kill her when a Shrike takes her over.
adds.evidence: New Life (S6E13, #123): a Shrike infects Yo-Yo; Mack is given the Shrike dagger but fails to kill her, she turns and attacks him; May kills Izel, destroying the Shrike, and Mack holds Yo-Yo.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#6
adds.text: Mack and Elena rescue his parents in 1976, and he introduces her as his girlfriend. When his parents turn out to be Chronicom copies and his real parents dead, Elena comforts him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's girlfriend, who comforts him when his parents turn out to be Chronicoms.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Elena's boyfriend, who introduces her to his parents in 1976.
adds.evidence: Adapt or Die (S7E6): Yo-Yo goes with Mack to rescue John and Lilla Mackenzie, he introduces her as his girlfriend; the parents are revealed as Chronicoms, his real parents dead, and Yo-Yo comforts him. Through S7 they remain a couple (date night in S7E5, reunion hug in S7E7).

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#20
adds.text: May flies Lash to Hive's base to fight him. Lash dies saving Daisy, and May sits beside his body and mourns him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Andrew's ex-wife, who mourns him when he dies as Lash.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: May's ex-husband, who dies as Lash saving Daisy. She mourns him.
adds.evidence: Emancipation (S3E20, #64): May flies Lash on a Quinjet to Hive's hideout; Lash frees Daisy from Hive and is fatally wounded by Hellfire; his body is returned to the Playground, where May sits beside it and mourns her ex-husband.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Bruce and Natasha share an awkward reunion at the Avengers Compound after two years apart, and she tells him which Avengers are under house arrest.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old flame. Their reunion after two years apart is awkward.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old flame, back after two years missing. Their reunion is awkward.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Infinity War: at the Compound Banner emerges after being missing two years; 'Hi, Bruce.' 'Nat.'; Sam notes the meeting is awkward; Natasha tells Banner Clint and Scott are under house arrest. They are no longer together, so friend matches the later Endgame stage.

adds.title: Captain Marvel
adds.text: After the Snap, Bruce and Natasha watch over Fury's pager at the Avengers Compound. Bruce doubts they even know what it is, and Natasha says Fury did and that she wants to know who is on the other end.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who wants to know who Fury's pager is calling.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who doubts they know what Fury's pager even is.
adds.evidence: Captain Marvel mid-credits scene (belongs to the film): Banner: 'We don't even know what this is.' Romanoff: 'Fury did... I wanna know who's on the other end of that thing.'

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Paxton and Maggie pick Cassie up from her father's house during his house arrest and later take her back there for her soccer shoes. When Scott is freed, Cassie and Paxton run out to hug him together.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Cassie's stepfather, who picks her up from her dad's house.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Paxton's stepdaughter, whom he picks up from her dad's house.
adds.evidence: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Paxton and Maggie arrive at Scott's house to pick up Cassie; the next day they take her back for her soccer shoes, where Cassie stalls the FBI; at the end Cassie, Paxton and Maggie give Scott a group hug at their house.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Maggie collects Cassie from her father's house after a weekend there and helps her pack, then takes her back for her forgotten soccer shoes.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Cassie's mother, who collects her from her dad's house.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Maggie's daughter, collected from her dad's house after a weekend.
adds.evidence: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Maggie and Paxton pick up Cassie from Scott's house; Maggie helps Cassie pack after the weekend with her father; they video call Scott about Cassie's soccer shoes and take her back to fetch them.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Cassie plays games with her father during his house arrest. When he suits up as Ant-Man again, she tells him he needs a partner to watch his back, meaning herself, and he refuses.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Cassie's dad, who refuses her offer to be his partner.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Scott's daughter, who offers to be his partner.
adds.evidence: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Scott and Cassie play a cardboard-tunnel treasure game during house arrest; after the FBI leaves she says he needs someone watching his back, like a partner, meaning herself; he refuses.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Scott escapes the Quantum Realm and finds Cassie a teenager, five years after he vanished, and they share a tearful reunion. After the Blip is undone, they watch the fireworks together.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Cassie's dad, who comes back after five years in the Quantum Realm.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Scott's daughter, a teenager when he returns after five years.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame: in 2023 Cassie, now fifteen, answers the door to find Scott; they share an emotional reunion; after the Blip they watch fireworks outside her house with Hope.

adds.title: The Defenders#1
adds.text: Danny and Colleen hunt the Hand together in Cambodia, then follow the fight back to New York.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Colleen's boyfriend, who hunts the Hand with her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, who hunts the Hand with him.
adds.evidence: The Defenders episode 1 'The H Word': while hunting agents of the Hand in Cambodia, Danny Rand and Colleen Wing are told the war is actually in New York City; Colleen is Rand's lover through the miniseries.

owner_calls.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
owner_calls.question: In gym class Ned interrupts Betty, Liz and friends' talk about the Avengers to blurt that Peter knows Spider-Man. Is a remark to her group enough for a stage before Far From Home?
options: Add stage (friend): 'Ned interrupts Betty and her friends talking about the Avengers to blurt out that Peter knows Spider-Man.' Cards: 'A classmate who blurts out that Peter knows Spider-Man.' / 'A classmate whose talk about the Avengers Ned interrupts.'
No stage: a line aimed at the whole group, not a dealing between the two
owner_calls.evidence: Spider-Man: Homecoming: in gym class Betty, Liz, Seymour and Jason play a game about the Avengers; Ned interrupts by blurting out that Peter Parker knows Spider-Man.

owner_calls.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
owner_calls.question: In the theatrical cut they never deal with each other (Betty only reports on Peter's return). The extended 'More Fun Stuff Version' (and Daily Bugle tie-in videos) adds Betty awkwardly interviewing her ex Ned for Midtown News. Does the extended cut count as on screen?
options: Add stage (friend): 'Betty interviews her ex-boyfriend Ned for the school news, and they awkwardly compliment each other's looks.' Cards: 'Betty's ex-boyfriend, whom she awkwardly interviews.' / 'Ned's ex-girlfriend, who awkwardly interviews him.'
owner_calls.evidence: Spider-Man: No Way Home - The More Fun Stuff Version: Betty interviews Ned; they awkwardly compliment each other and talk about what to text an ex. Not in the theatrical cut.
